Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you
were involved in in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the details of the accident. My name is on the claim form.
Q: That's fine, but I need it stated on the recording for our file. Could you confirm it?
A: Okay. It's the name on my policy paperwork.
Q: Thank you. Can you describe what happened as best you remember?
A: I was stopped at a traffic light on a main road in Conroe, waiting for the signal to change. The traffic had been
moving slowly. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car was pushed forward into the intersection.
Q: Were you able to see the vehicle that struck you before the impact?
A: Not really. I was looking ahead at the light. I thnik it was a pickup truck, but I only saw it in my mirror after it hit me.
Q: Did you stop at the light or were you still moving when you were hit?
A: I had come to a complete stop. My foot was on the brake.
Q: How did you feel immediately after the collision?
A: My chest hurt from the seatbelt and my right wrist felt wrong right away. I couldn't grip the steering wheel properly.
Q: Did you seek medical treatment?
A: Yes. An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed the wrist and told me it was fractured. I've
since been referred to an orthopedic specialist and I'm wearing a splint.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble doing everyday things like typing and cooking. I'd like to know what happens next
with the claim.
Q: I'll explain the next steps at the end of our call. Thank you for your cooperation.
</page>

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
